channel.title: Joe Hartmann Finds
channel.description: Joe Hartmann Finds is a growing collection of Amazon affiliate finds from Joe Hartmann's Pinterest boards, each with a short article and links to the pin and to Amazon.

item.title: Back Seat Cover for Kids – 2 Pack Waterproof Kick Mats with 3-Pocket Storage Organizer
item.description: A closer look at the lebogner 2-pack waterproof kick mats, X-large 19 x 27 inch seat back protectors with three storage pockets, buckle straps, and an anti-slip design for keeping front seats clean.

item.title: Tevlaphee Windshield Cover for Ice & Snow – Heavy Duty Waterproof Magnetic Frost Protector
item.description: A closer look at the Tevlaphee windshield cover for ice and snow, made from 600D Oxford fabric with a soft inner lining, five embedded magnets, side mirror protectors, and a storage pouch.

item.title: ROVE R2 DUAL Dash Cam Front & Rear – STARVIS 2 Night Vision, Loop Recording with 128GB Card
item.description: A closer look at the ROVE R2 DUAL front and rear dash cam, with a Sony STARVIS 2 front sensor, 2.5K front and 1080P rear recording, loop recording, G-sensor, built-in GPS, 5.8GHz WiFi app access, and an included 128GB card.

item.title: EcoNour Car Windshield Sun Shade – Foldable Sun Blocker to Keep Your Car Cooler
item.description: A closer look at the EcoNour windshield sun shade, a foldable 240T polyester sun blocker with an expandable overlap design that installs in seconds and packs into an included storage pouch.

item.title: Chemical Guys Nifty Carpet & Upholstery Brush – Heavy Duty Car Interior Detailing Brush
item.description: A closer look at the Chemical Guys Nifty heavy duty carpet and upholstery brush (ACCG25), a stiff-bristle detailing brush with an ergonomic grip for scrubbing carpets, floor mats, and cloth seats.

item.title: Car Cup Holder Expander – Adjustable Base Fits Large 16–46 oz Water Bottles & Mugs
item.description: A closer look at the TYKOR car cup holder expander, with a twist-to-adjust base, an offset design, rubber tabs and a coaster for stability, a built-in phone holder, and room for 16–46 oz bottles.

item.title: PULIDIKI Car Cleaning Gel – Reusable Putty Dust Cleaner for Vents, Keyboards & Interior
item.description: A closer look at PULIDIKI car cleaning gel, a lavender-scented reusable putty that presses into vents, cup holders, and crevices to lift dust and crumbs, and also works on keyboards and remotes.

item.title: AstroAI L7 Cordless Tire Inflator – 150 PSI Portable Air Compressor for Cars, Bikes & Balls
item.description: A closer look at the AstroAI L7 cordless tire inflator, a rechargeable 150 PSI portable compressor with a digital pressure display, preset modes, auto shut-off, a built-in flashlight, and USB power-bank ports.

item.title: Febreze Car Air Freshener Vent Clip – Odor-Fighting Unstopables Fresh Scent, Long Lasting
item.description: A closer look at the Febreze car air freshener vent clip in Unstopables Fresh, a 4-count pack of odor-fighting clips with adjustable intensity and up to 40 days of scent per clip.

item.title: Helteko Backseat Car Organizer – Kick Mat Protector with Tablet Holder & 9 Storage Pockets
item.description: A closer look at the Helteko backseat car organizer 2-pack, a kick mat that covers the back of the front seats and adds 9 storage pockets, including a clear touch-screen tablet holder, with adjustable straps.

item.title: AstroAI Windshield Cleaner Tool – Interior Glass Cleaning Kit with Extendable Handle
item.description: A closer look at the AstroAI windshield cleaner kit, with a 180° rotating head, a telescoping 15.9–21 inch handle that splits for storage, four washable microfiber pads, a 60ml spray bottle, and a storage bag.

item.title: NOCO Boost GB40 1000A Portable Lithium Jump Starter – UltraSafe 12V Car Battery Booster Pack
item.description: A closer look at the NOCO Boost GB40, a 1000-amp 12V lithium jump starter rated for gas engines up to 6.0L and diesel up to 3.0L, with spark-proof and reverse polarity protection, a USB power bank, and a 100-lumen LED flashlight.

item.title: AstroAI Digital Tire Pressure Gauge – 150 PSI, ±1 PSI Accuracy for Cars & Trucks
item.description: A closer look at the AstroAI digital tire pressure gauge, with a 0–150 PSI range, factory calibration to ±1 PSI, a backlit display and lighted nozzle, four units, and auto-off to save battery.

item.title: Lusso Gear Car Trash Can – 2.5 Gallon, Leak-Proof with Lid & Liner for Back Seat Storage
item.description: A closer look at the Lusso Gear 2.5-gallon car trash can in black, with a flip-top lid, removable waterproof leak-proof liner, mesh side pockets, a front zipper pocket, and a design that hangs on the front or back seat.

item.title: Chemical Guys Professional Microfiber Towels – 16×16 in, 12 Pack for Car Washing & Detailing
item.description: A closer look at the Chemical Guys Professional Microfiber Towels 12-pack in gold, with 16 x 16 inch high-pile towels for drying, buffing wax, cleaning glass and wiping interiors, and machine-washable construction.

item.title: 6-Piece Car Detailing Brush Set – Boar's Hair & Soft Brushes for Vents, Wheels & Interior
item.description: A closer look at the MVEQRRN 6-piece car detailing brush set, with two boar's hair brushes, two multicolor detailing brushes, and two ultra-soft synthetic brushes for air vents, dashboards, leather seats, wheels, and more.

item.title: BLACK+DECKER dustbuster AdvancedClean Cordless Handheld Vacuum – Crevice Tool & Charging Station
item.description: A closer look at the BLACK+DECKER dustbuster AdvancedClean cordless handheld vacuum (CHV1410L), with a 16V MAX lithium-ion battery, rotating slim nozzle, pull-out crevice tool, flip-up brush, cyclonic action, and a washable, translucent dirt bowl.

item.title: Magnetic Car Phone Mount for MagSafe – Strong Magnet Dash Holder for iPhone Navigation
item.description: A closer look at the Kaistyle magnetic MagSafe car mount, a compact dash-mounted phone holder with VHB adhesive, a 360-degree swivel ball joint, and included metal rings for phones and cases without MagSafe.

item.title: GORILLA GRIP Trunk Organizer for SUV & Cars – Large Capacity, Foldable Multi-Compartment Storage
item.description: A closer look at the GORILLA GRIP large-capacity trunk organizer, with corrugated plastic panels, water and tear resistant fabric, a slip resistant base, cargo straps, and a design that folds flat or opens to one or two compartments.

item.title: Drop Stop Car Seat Gap Fillers – 2 Pack Original Gap Blockers So Nothing Falls Under the Seat
item.description: A closer look at the Drop Stop original car seat gap fillers, a 2-pack of neoprene gap blockers that attach to the seat belt catch, move with the seat, and come with a slide-free dash pad and LED light.

item.title: Manual Impact Driver Set – 26-Piece Reversible Hand Impact Driver with Bits and Screw Extractors
item.description: A closer look at the AKM 26-piece hand impact driver set, with a reversible chrome-plated driver, 1/2 and 3/8 inch adapters, S2 steel bits, extension sockets, and two screw extractors for stuck and rusted fasteners.

item.title: Safety Work Gloves 12-Pack – PU Coated Nylon with Grip for Gardening, Mechanic and DIY Work
item.description: A closer look at DULFINE's 12-pair PU-coated work gloves, with a seamless 13-gauge nylon knit shell, polyurethane-coated palms and fingers, and knit wrists for light to medium duty jobs.

item.title: CRAFTSMAN V20 MAX Cordless Tool Kit – Circular Saw, Drill/Driver, Impact Driver and Light
item.description: A closer look at the CRAFTSMAN V20 MAX 4-tool combo kit (CMCK401D2AM), with a 1/2 inch drill/driver, 1/4 inch impact driver, 6-1/2 inch circular saw, LED task light, two batteries, and a charger.

item.title: CRAFTSMAN V20 Cordless Hammer Drill Kit – 1/2 Inch, 2 Batteries and Charger
item.description: A closer look at the CRAFTSMAN V20 1/2 inch cordless hammer drill kit (CMCD711C2), with a ratcheting chuck, two-speed gearbox, hammer mode for masonry, two V20 batteries, and a charger.

item.title: DURATECH 25FT Magnetic Tape Measure – Double-Sided Easy Read with Magnetic Hook
item.description: A closer look at the DURATECH 25 ft magnetic tape measure, with a nylon-coated carbon steel blade, double-sided 1/8 inch fractional markings, a magnetic hook, and a sliding thumb lock.

item.title: INCLY 278-Piece Pegboard Accessories Kit – Hooks, Bins & Organizers for Garage Tool Storage
item.description: A closer look at the INCLY 278-piece pegboard accessories kit, with 16 hook types, 12 bins, a ring tool holder, a multi-tool rack, and 109 peg locks, sized for standard 1/8 and 1/4 inch pegboard.

item.title: WORKPRO 3-Pack Folding Utility Knives – Quick-Change Box Cutters with Belt Clips
item.description: A closer look at the WORKPRO 3-pack EDC folding utility knife set, with one-handed opening, a button lock, tool-free blade changes that take standard utility blades, a belt clip, and a compact 3-inch closed size.

item.title: WORKPRO 12 Inch Magnetic Torpedo Level – Four Vials, Magnetic Edge, Aluminum Frame
item.description: A closer look at the WORKPRO 12 inch magnetic torpedo level, with four vials including a multi-pitch vial, a magnetic edge, a shock-absorbing aluminum frame, a V-groove bottom, and a tapered shape that fits a tool pouch.

item.title: Franklin Sensors ProSensor M210 Stud Finder – 13 Sensors Show Full Stud Width, Live Wire Detection
item.description: A closer look at the Franklin Sensors ProSensor M210 stud finder, with 13 sensors, an LED display that shows full stud width and center, deep scanning for wood and metal studs, live wire detection, and a built-in bubble level.

item.title: NoCry Clear Safety Glasses – Anti-Fog, Scratch-Resistant Wraparound Lenses, ANSI Z87.1
item.description: A closer look at NoCry clear safety glasses, with polycarbonate wraparound lenses, an anti-fog and scratch-resistant coating, 100% UV protection, adjustable temples and nose pads, and ANSI Z87.1 certification.

item.title: CRAFTSMAN 25 Ft Tape Measure – Self-Locking Retractable Blade with Fraction Markings
item.description: A closer look at the CRAFTSMAN 25-foot Self-Lock tape measure (CMHT37225S), with a blade that locks automatically until you press a button, fractions printed on the blade, and a rubber overmold for grip.

item.title: Komelon SL2825 Self Lock 25-Foot Tape Measure – Auto-Lock Blade with Push-Button Return
item.description: A closer look at the Komelon SL2825 Self Lock 25-foot tape measure, with a blade that locks automatically, a push-button return, a 1-inch nylon-coated blade, stud markings, and a rubber-protected case.

item.title: Jorgensen 6" E-Z Hold Bar Clamps – 2-Pack One-Handed Clamps for Woodworking
item.description: A closer look at the Jorgensen 6-inch E-Z Hold medium-duty bar clamps two-pack, with one-handed operation, a 3-3/8-inch throat, a 400 lb load limit, and a design that converts from clamp to spreader.

item.title: Klein Tools 11063W Automatic Wire Stripper and Cutter – One-Squeeze Stripping for Electrical Work
item.description: A closer look at the Klein Tools 11063W automatic wire stripper and cutter, which strips 8-20 AWG solid and 10-22 AWG stranded wire in one squeeze and cuts up to 8 AWG solid wire.

item.title: SEEKONE 1800W Heat Gun – Variable Temperature Control for Crafts, Shrink Wrap, and Paint Removal
item.description: A closer look at the SEEKONE 1800W heat gun, with variable temperature control from 122°F to 1202°F, two airflow modes, overheat protection, and four nozzles for shrink tubing, PVC, paint removal, and 3D print finishing.

item.title: BLACK+DECKER Heat Gun – Corded, Dual Temperature Settings for Paint Stripping & More
item.description: A closer look at the BLACK+DECKER HG1300 corded heat gun, with 750°F and 1,000°F settings, 1,350 watts, a built-in stand, and a 3-position side handle for stripping paint, loosening rusted nuts, and thawing pipes.

item.title: AVID POWER Oscillating Multi Tool – 3.5-Amp Corded Kit with Blades, Sanding Pad & 6 Variable Speeds
item.description: A closer look at the AVID POWER 3.5-amp corded oscillating multi tool, with a 4.5° oscillation angle, 6 variable speeds, tool-free blade changes, an auxiliary handle, and a starter set of blades and sanding accessories.

item.title: CRAFTSMAN 20V MAX Cordless Impact Driver Kit – 1/4 Inch, 2,800 RPM with LED Light & Battery
item.description: A closer look at the CRAFTSMAN 20V MAX 1/4 inch impact driver kit (CMCF800C1), with 1,460 in-lbs of torque, up to 2,800 RPM, a quick-release chuck, LED work light, battery, and charger.

item.title: BLACK+DECKER 20V MAX POWERCONNECT Cordless Drill Driver Kit with Accessory Set
item.description: A closer look at the BLACK+DECKER 20V MAX POWERCONNECT cordless drill driver kit, with a 24-position clutch, soft-grip handle, bits and accessories, a battery and charger, and a zippered storage case.

item.title: DEWALT 20V MAX Cordless Drill & Impact Driver Combo Kit – 2 Batteries, Charger & Bag
item.description: A closer look at the DEWALT 20V MAX drill/driver and impact driver combo kit (DCK240C2), with two batteries, a charger, a contractor bag, compact tools, and LED work lights.

item.title: Contigo West Loop Travel Mug 16 oz – Spill-Proof Autoseal Insulated Stainless Steel Coffee Mug
item.description: A closer look at the Contigo West Loop 16 oz travel mug, a stainless steel mug with a leak-proof, spill-proof AUTOSEAL lid, THERMALOCK vacuum insulation, one-handed drinking, and a cup-holder-friendly fit.

item.title: Digital Luggage Scale 110 lb – Handheld Suitcase Weight Scale with Backlit LCD for Travel
item.description: A closer look at a compact digital luggage scale with a 110 lb / 50 kg capacity, backlit LCD, auto-lock reading, lb/kg switching, and a nylon strap with a steel hook.

item.title: Compression Packing Cubes 6-Pack – Beige Expandable Travel Organizers for Luggage
item.description: A closer look at the Aerotrunk compression packing cubes 6-pack in beige, nylon twill cubes in an assortment of sizes with a double zipper compression design and a breathable mesh top.

item.title: Cabeau Evolution S3 Travel Pillow – Memory Foam Neck Pillow That Straps to the Airplane Seat
item.description: A closer look at the Cabeau Evolution S3 travel pillow, a memory foam neck pillow with raised side supports, a flat back, and an adjustable Seat Strap System that helps keep your head from falling forward.

item.title: BAGSMART Travel Toiletry Bag – Wide-Open Makeup & Cosmetic Organizer Bag for Travel Essentials
item.description: A closer look at the BAGSMART wide-open travel toiletry bag, a soft puffy organizer with four compartments, an upright bottle section, and a waterproof PVC pocket for keeping wet and dry items apart.

item.title: Veken Packing Cubes Set – Travel Luggage Organizers for Carry-On & Suitcase
item.description: A closer look at Veken packing cubes, a set of polyester travel organizers with mesh panels, two-way metal zippers, buckled cubes, and a toiletry bag, shoe bag, and laundry bag. Sold in 8-piece and 10-piece sets.

item.title: INIU Portable Charger 10000mAh 45W – Slim Fast Charging Travel Power Bank with USB-C
item.description: A closer look at the INIU 10000mAh 45W portable charger, a compact, TSA-compliant power bank with a detachable USB-C cable, USB-C and USB-A outputs, and about two phone charges per fill.

item.title: Anker Nano Travel Adapter – Compact Universal Charger with 2 USB-C Ports for Phone & Travel
item.description: A closer look at the Anker Nano Travel Adapter, a credit card-sized universal adapter with Type A, C, G, and I plugs, one AC outlet, 2 USB-C and 2 USB-A ports, and 20W max USB output. Not a voltage converter.

item.title: EPICKA Universal Travel Adapter – International Plug Adapter with USB-C and USB-A Ports
item.description: A closer look at the EPICKA universal travel adapter, an all-in-one plug adapter with US, EU, UK, and AU plugs, one AC socket, 3 USB-C and 2 USB-A ports, and a replaceable fuse. Not a voltage converter.

item.title: OXO Good Grips Garlic Press – Easy-Squeeze Garlic Crusher with Built-In Cleaner
item.description: A closer look at the OXO Good Grips Garlic Press, a die-cast zinc garlic crusher with a large-capacity chamber, soft non-slip handles, a flip-over built-in cleaner, and dishwasher-safe cleanup.
